claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified for model-card purposes based on aggregate readiness and rehearsal results, despite the current fraud dispute review subgroup regression, because certification would be supportable if the current release documentation discloses that limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed before launch unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and rehearsal results are supportive but do not override a missing required disclosure or approval link.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but are not substitutes for current-release evidence.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing explicit disclosure of the fraud dispute review regression for the launch use case.
If disclosure is not present, provide an approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering that subgroup weakness before launch.
Provide the final certification packet or approval artifact tying the current eval batch to the current release documentation.
specific_concerns: The admissible evidence shows a current material subgroup weakness for a named launch use case: the fraud dispute review slice is 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold.
The policy requires that material launch-use-case limitations be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The record provided does not include the current release documentation or model-card text showing that this regression has actually been disclosed.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is explicitly unsupported by reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family is only contextual and cannot satisfy the current-release documentation requirement after the retrieval configuration change and new eval batch.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record, rather than conditionally supportable only if the current release documentation is updated.
Any implication that aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are sufficient by themselves to satisfy the certification policy.
Any reliance on the informal monitoring comment as an approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
